North Dakota Teams Achieve Dominant Football Victories

North Dakota State University secured a decisive 38-0 victory over Fordham University, advancing their record to 2-0 in their inaugural Football Bowl Subdivision season. Separately, the University of North Dakota achieved a significant win against St. Thomas, with quarterback Kaminski throwing five touchdown passes in a 62-26 outcome. Both teams demonstrated strong offensive performances in their respective games.
